sc-render-smart-button="false" itemscope=""> <section class="article-container" data-stats-ve="35"><h1>Use &amp; manage connected apps in Gemini Notebook</h1><div class="article-content-container"><div class="cc"><p>To complete your request and give you more helpful responses, Gemini Notebook chat can connect to other apps.</p>

<p><strong>Important: </strong>This feature is only available on the web.</p>

<h2>Use connected apps in Gemini Notebook</h2>

<ol>
  <li>On your device, go to <a href="https://notebook.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank"><u>notebook.google.com</u></a>.</li>
  <li>​In the “Chat” panel, enter a question or prompt that mentions the connected app.</li>
  <li>Select Send <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/sKcXMOJFkyt-h_1oa_FDcoYlOqrpPG7VVwi8xSC1lB5ko1FaPpvfBCs28yNuzFDIng=h48" width="auto" height="24" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/sKcXMOJFkyt-h_1oa_FDcoYlOqrpPG7VVwi8xSC1lB5ko1FaPpvfBCs28yNuzFDIng">.
    <ul>
      <li>If an app is connected and enabled, Gemini Notebook automatically uses it.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ol>

<h2>Browse available apps &amp; their supported actions</h2>

<p>You can find apps that you can connect to Gemini Notebook and info about them.</p>

<ol>
  <li>On your device, go to <a href="https://notebook.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank"><u>notebook.google.com</u></a>.</li>
  <li>At the top, select Settings <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Mk6Y-0vQSXMK5vq0-uGfEbbEREn1NPeveQwT62eL84tBD_TW56Rm0220OqOLw5ebCw=h48" width="auto" height="24" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Mk6Y-0vQSXMK5vq0-uGfEbbEREn1NPeveQwT62eL84tBD_TW56Rm0220OqOLw5ebCw">&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Connected apps</strong>.</li>
  <li>Select an app. On the app’s details page, you can find:
    <ul>
      <li>The app’s full description</li>
      <li>Supported actions</li>
      <li>Example prompts</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ol>

<h2>Manage connected apps in your notebooks</h2>

<p>When you connect a new connected app, it is enabled for all of your notebooks. You can disable a specific connected app at the notebook level. When you disable or enable an app in one notebook, that setting does not carry over to other notebooks.&nbsp;</p>

<ol>
  <li>On your device, go to <a href="https://notebook.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank"><u>notebook.google.com</u></a>.</li>
  <li>Create a new notebook or open an existing notebook.</li>
  <li>​In the “Chat” panel, select Configure Chat <img src="//storage.googleapis.com/support-kms-prod/ZRY13uzCf7JrK2mLDk3g7w9vfsWt2vwzLeMf" width="auto" height="24" alt="" data-mime-type="image/svg+xml">.</li>
  <li>Find the app you want to enable or disable.
    <ul>
      <li>To enable an app, turn it on <img src="//storage.googleapis.com/support-kms-prod/ogumrzFPBnkhRqu2iTb4AnLi867gQazGVlkV" width="auto" height="24" alt="" data-mime-type="image/svg+xml">.</li>
      <li>To disable an app, turn it off <img src="//storage.googleapis.com/support-kms-prod/DX6YzE0L6MptEu5hID5OstidGN0noKeOzjXh" width="auto" height="24" alt="" data-mime-type="image/svg+xml">.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ol>

<h2>Related resources</h2>

<ul>

  <li><a href="/gemininotebook/answer/16206563" rel="noopener"><u>Create a notebook in Gemini Notebook</u></a></li>
</ul>
